summary: Use small references and targeted tools to localize asynchronous launch, memory and synchronization failures.
outcomes: Distinguish launch errors from execution errors reported later.
Choose memory, race, initialization and synchronization checks for a suspected bug.
sequence: Reduce a wrong result to a tiny reproducible case.
Place error checks at submission and completion boundaries.
Run targeted sanitizer modes and read the first causal report.
Use device debug information, assertions or a debugger for localization.
Repair and rerun the full input and synchronization matrix.

visual.question: Why is the reported API call later than the actual invalid access?
visual.interaction: Step a failing launch and reveal when each check observes the error.

practice.task: Diagnose four seeded memory, initialization, race and barrier faults.
practice.success: Each repair has a minimal reproducer, correct reference output and relevant clean tool run.
